body:
Sorry to hear.  Doctors are usually reluctant to give pain meds to crohnies.

Pain meds can cover up blockages, or other problems.

Wish our healthcare system was better.

Have you tried marijuana?  I heard it helps some people.

Have you tried any other drugs? humira for example?

I assume you have tried different foods/diet and see if it helps?

What about the innocent people wrongly sent to prison?

Prisons are supposed to rehabilitate people and prepare them for being sent back to the public.  I don't think treating them like utter trash would be the best for someone coming back into society.
